templates.title: First visit
templates.summary: The door, the order, the first taste and why you would come back.

typedFallback.hint: The dish or drink you are ordering

steps.title: Arrive
steps.position: Outside, across from the entrance
steps.direction: Start across from the door with it centered in the frame, then walk straight at it at an even pace until it fills the screen.

captions.script: Found it. First time at {venue.name}.
New spot for me. Walking in to try it.

steps.line: First time at {venue.name}. Walking in to see what's on the menu.
steps.caption: {venue.name}
steps.idea: The front of the place, so people can find it.

steps.title: Order
steps.position: At the counter, behind your own shoulder
steps.direction: Hold the phone still over your shoulder toward the menu board and the barista, and ask what first-timers order.
steps.prompter: Asking the barista what first-timers usually order here.

captions.script: Asking the barista what first-timers usually order here.
At the counter, picking my first order here.

steps.line: Asking the barista what first-timers usually order here.
steps.caption: Ordering at the counter
steps.idea: Where you order, with the menu or the barista in view.

steps.title: The menu
steps.position: Seated, menu flat on the table
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the menu, elbows on the table, and keep it still on the dish you are ordering.

captions.script: This is the menu. I'm getting {menuItem.name}.
Reading the menu. I'm ordering {menuItem.name}.

steps.line: Picking from the menu. I'm ordering {menuItem.name}.
steps.caption: The menu
steps.idea: The menu on the table, with the dish you are ordering.

steps.title: Your drink
steps.position: At your table, cup on its saucer
steps.direction: Put the cup on your table and film it close: circle it or slide past it until the steam and the handle show.

captions.script: First time at {venue.name}. This is my cup.
My order, on the table at {venue.name}.

steps.idea: Your drink on the table, close enough to see the steam.

steps.title: The plate
steps.position: Seated, phone low beside your plate
steps.direction: When the plate lands, film it close: circle it with your elbows on the table, or slide the phone along a napkin.

captions.script: Here it comes. My first plate at {venue.name}.
The plate, on the table at {venue.name}.

steps.idea: The dish on the table, close enough to see what it is.

steps.title: First sip
steps.position: Sitting at a table
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length with the cup in frame. Take a sip, lean in a little and react in your own words.

captions.script: First sip at {venue.name}. {opinion}
Trying my first cup here. {opinion}

steps.caption: First sip
steps.idea: You taking the first sip, your face and the cup in frame.

steps.title: First forkful
steps.position: Seated at the table
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, eyes level. Lift the first forkful toward the lens and react in your own words.

captions.script: First forkful at {venue.name}. {opinion}
Trying my first plate here. {opinion}

steps.caption: First bite
steps.idea: You taking the first bite, your face and the food in frame.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: At your table, phone behind your cup
steps.direction: Start with the lens right behind your cup, then slide sideways until the room shows.

captions.script: Grabbed a table. This is the view from my seat.
This is where I'm sitting at {venue.name}.

steps.idea: The room from your seat, so people see where they would sit.
steps.line: Grabbed a table. This is the view from my seat.
steps.caption: The room

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: At the table, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, eyes level. Say where you are and whether you would come back.

captions.script: That's {venue.name}. Would I come back? {opinion}
First visit to {venue.name} done. Coming back? {opinion}

steps.caption: {venue.name}
steps.idea: You, looking at the lens, saying why you would come back.

templates.title: Morning ritual
templates.summary: A slow morning: the room in early light, the steaming cup, a pastry torn open and your corner.

steps.title: Morning light
steps.position: Inside, by the window
steps.direction: Stand still and turn slowly from the window across the room, phone at chest height, turning your hips, not your wrists.

captions.script: Slow mornings start here. Soft light, a warm cup and nowhere to be.
Good morning from my favourite window seat in the neighbourhood.
Right before work, and this is where I spend the time.

steps.title: The cup
steps.position: At the table, phone at cup height
steps.direction: Rest your elbows on the table, phone level with the cup, and hold still while the steam rises. Then flick the phone right.

captions.script: Fresh cup, still steaming. Nothing beats the first sip.
The usual: same order, same cup, same table.
Not too strong, not too sweet. Just right for a slow start.

steps.title: Something sweet
steps.position: At the table, phone above the plate
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the plate at an angle and tear the pastry in half toward the lens, leaning in slowly as the layers open.

captions.script: Straight from the case. You can see the layers inside.
Listen to that crust when it breaks. Layers all the way through.
This pastry with my usual cup. Every morning, no exceptions.

steps.title: Your corner
steps.position: Sitting at the table
steps.direction: Back camera from your eyes onto the table: your hands, the cup, a book or laptop. Lean back slowly as you talk.
steps.prompter: Same seat every morning, my usual order, and nowhere to be.

captions.script: Same seat every morning, my usual order, and nowhere to be.
No rush here. Order something good, take the window seat and stay.

templates.title: Before opening
templates.summary: Behind the bar before the doors open: the room waking up, the first shot pulled and the first cup out.

steps.title: Lights on
steps.position: Inside, by the door, before opening
steps.direction: Ask the barista first. Hold the phone still from the door while the lights come on and the chairs come down.

captions.script: Before opening, and the cafe is still waking up.
This is what happens here before anyone walks in.

steps.title: Dial in
steps.position: Behind the barista's shoulder
steps.direction: Stand behind the barista's shoulder and hold still while they grind, weigh and tamp the first dose.

captions.script: First job of the day: dial in the grinder before the line starts.
Grind, weigh, tamp. Same steps every morning, before every shot.

steps.title: First shot
steps.position: Beside the machine, phone at cup height
steps.direction: Phone level with the cup under the spout. As the espresso runs, move in slowly until the crema fills the screen.

captions.script: First shot of the day, pulled before the doors open.
Listen to the machine. Watch the crema build as it runs.

steps.title: First cup out
steps.position: At the counter, customer side
steps.direction: Hold the phone above the counter at an angle, almost touching the cup, then lean back slowly as the first customer picks it up. Film hands, not faces.

captions.script: Doors open, and the first cup of the day goes out.
First customer of the morning, and the first cup goes to them.

steps.title: Your cup
steps.position: At the counter or a table, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, cup in frame. Say what you got, the price and what time they open.
steps.prompter: Here is when they open, what I got and what it costs.

captions.script: Here is when they open, what I got and what it costs.
If you come at opening, you get the first shot and no line.

templates.title: Seasonal drink
templates.summary: The drink of the season: the finishing touch, the build, the first sip, the price on the board and the verdict.

steps.title: Finishing touch
steps.position: At the counter, phone above the cup
steps.direction: Hold the phone straight above the cup while the barista adds the topping or the dusting. Lean in slowly as it lands.

captions.script: It's back, but only for this season.
New on the menu, and I had to come and try it.

steps.title: The build
steps.position: Beside the counter, phone at cup height
steps.direction: Phone level with the glass, elbows on the counter. Hold still while each part of the drink goes in.

captions.script: Here's how it's made, step by step, right in front of me.
Layer by layer, watch each part go into the glass.

steps.title: First sip
steps.position: At the counter or a table
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, drink in frame. Take a sip, lean in a little and say how it tastes.
steps.prompter: The seasonal drink is back, but not for long. First sip.

captions.script: The seasonal drink is back, but not for long. First sip.
Sweeter than a latte, but you still taste the coffee.

steps.title: On the board
steps.position: In front of the counter, looking up
steps.direction: Start on the menu board where the drink and its price are written, then tilt the phone down slowly to the drink on the counter.

captions.script: Here is how long it stays on the board before it's gone.
Here's the price, written right next to the regular lattes.

steps.title: Verdict
steps.position: At a table, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera held a little above eye level with the drink in frame. Give your verdict and the price.
steps.prompter: Here's the price, how sweet it is, and whether I'd get another.

captions.script: Here's the price, how sweet it is, and whether I'd get another.
If you like it sweet, get it before it's off the menu.

templates.title: Work spot test
templates.summary: Can you work here: the room, your table, the outlets and the wifi, and a score with the best seat.

steps.title: The question
steps.position: At the door or a table
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, laptop bag or cup in frame. Ask the question straight to the lens.
steps.prompter: Can you actually work here for a whole afternoon? Let's test it.

captions.script: Can you actually work here for a whole afternoon? Let's test it.
Laptop test: seats, outlets, wifi and noise. Here we go.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: In the middle of the room
steps.direction: Stand still and turn slowly across the tables, hips and phone together. At the end, flick the phone fast to the right.

captions.script: Here are the tables, the light, and how busy it gets.
Listen to the room and judge if a call would work here.

steps.title: Your table
steps.position: Sitting at your table
steps.direction: Back camera from your eyes onto the table: laptop, drink and pastry. Move in slowly toward the cup.

captions.script: Laptop, my drink and a snack. That's my office today.
Here is how much fits on the table next to the laptop.

steps.title: Outlets and wifi
steps.position: At your table, phone over the edge
steps.direction: Start on the table edge, then tilt the phone down slowly to the outlet under it, or to the wifi card on the table.

captions.script: Here is where the outlets are, so you know where to sit.
Here is how you get the wifi, and how well it held up.

steps.title: The score
steps.position: At your table, arm out
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, laptop and room behind you. Give a score out of ten and name the best seat.
steps.prompter: My score for working here, and the one seat worth grabbing.

captions.script: My score for working here, and the one seat worth grabbing.
Here is the seat to grab, and why it beats the rest.

entrance.reads: The door grows as we walk straight at it until it fills the frame; cut to the order.

counter.reads: From behind the shoulder the menu board and the barista hold still while the cup is handed over; match-cut on the cup in hand.

menu.reads: The menu held still from above with the dish's line readable; cut to the first forkful.

drink.reads: The latte art grows until it fills the frame from above; a whip off the cup lands on the door outside.

plate.reads: The plate grows from table height until the dish fills the frame; a whip off it lands on the door outside.

sip.reads: The cup rises and the face grows as the creator leans into the sip; cut back to arm's length.

forkful.reads: The fork comes up into a still selfie and the face answers; cut to the room behind the cup.

room.reads: The cup slides off and the room opens up behind it; cut to the verdict.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, face, cup and room held still while the price and the street land.

light.reads: The room slides past from the window to the counter in morning light; cut to the cup on the table.

cup.reads: The cup holds still with steam curling up; a whip to the right lands on the pastry beside it.

pastry.reads: The pastry splits and the layers grow toward the lens until the crumb fills the frame; cut to the creator's view of the table.

corner.reads: The table opens up around the hands and cup as the creator leans back, window light in frame.

lights.reads: The dark room fills with light while the barista moves through it; cut to behind the barista at the machine.

dial.reads: From behind the shoulder the hands grind and tamp; match-cut on the portafilter locking into the machine.

shot.reads: The espresso runs and the cup grows until the dark crema fills the frame; push through into the next cup leaving the counter.

door.reads: The cup lifts away from the lens and the counter opens up around it seen from above; cut to the creator holding their own cup.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, face and cup held still while the opening time and price land.

finish.reads: The topping lands and the foam grows until it fills the frame from above; cut to the side of the cup.

build.reads: The layers stack in the glass while the camera stays still; match-cut on the glass rising into the creator's hand.

sip.reads: The glass rises and the face grows into the sip; cut to the menu board above the counter.

board.reads: The board with the drink's name and price slides up out of frame as the drink on the counter comes in below.

verdict.reads: Arm's length from slightly above, face and drink held still while the verdict lands.

hook.reads: A face at arm's length asking the question, held still; cut to the room.

room.reads: The tables and windows slide past; a whip to the right lands on the creator's own table.

desk.reads: The table grows toward the cup as the creator leans in; cut to the table edge from above.

outlets.reads: The table edge slides up and the outlet or wifi card comes into frame below; cut to the creator's face.

score.reads: Arm's length, face and laptop held still while the score lands.
